message.content: In the conversation regarding the upcoming karaoke night, WolfgangSchulz suggests that they finalize their song list before the karaoke night. He proposes that they meet earlier than usual to go over new songs and ensure they are prepared for the event. Additionally, he encourages the group to pick a song list for the karaoke night, focusing on crowd-pleasers and including both familiar favorites and some fresh tracks. WolfgangSchulz also invites Yuriko to suggest a bass-heavy track, emphasizing the importance of having a diverse selection to cater to different preferences within the group.
